entries.text: Sense the types and numbers of your favored enemies within 60 feet.
Creates a magical snare. A creature entering it is entangled until it succeeds on a DC 23 Strength check.
Fire a spellslaying shot. On a successful attack it deals an extra 1d4 magical damage per level of the highest-level spell effect active on the target.
Assume the appearance of a tree. You become immobile, concealed, and immune to critical hits for one hour per caster level. Cast again to dismiss.
Blend with natural surroundings, gaining +20 Hide and +20 Move Silently for ten turns per caster level.
